title: Pure Pot of
summary: The 'Pot of' archetype celebrates Yu-Gi-Oh!'s most iconic draw vessels—Spirit of the Pot of Greed, Avatar of The Pot, Pot of Desires, Pot of Extravagance, Pot of Prosperity, Pot of Duality, Pot of Dichotomy, Pot of Avarice, and Pot of Acquisitiveness! Respecting the current TCG Banlist (where Pot of Prosperity and Pot of Extravagance are Limited to 1 copy each, and Pot of Greed is Forbidden), this deck combines the legal 'Pot of' spells with Spirit of the Pot of Greed and a Rock/Stun control core (Koa'ki Meiru Guardian, Koa'ki Meiru Overload, Thunder King Rai-Oh, and Gren Maju Da Eiza) that thrives under Pot of Duality's Special Summon lock and converts Pot banishes into massive ATK!

allow.Gren Maju Da Eiza: Level 3 Fiend that gains 400 ATK/DEF for every card banished by Pot of Desires (+4000 ATK!), Pot of Extravagance (+2400 ATK!), and Pot of Prosperity (+2400 ATK!).
allow.Koa'ki Meiru Guardian: Level 4 EARTH Rock (1900 ATK) that tributes itself to negate monster effects, putting a Rock type into the GY to help fuel Pot of Dichotomy!
allow.Koa'ki Meiru Overload: Level 4 EARTH Rock (1900 ATK) that tributes itself to negate Summons and fuel Pot of Dichotomy / Pot of Avarice.
allow.Thunder King Rai-Oh: Level 4 LIGHT Thunder (1900 ATK) that prevents both players from searching cards and tributes itself to negate Special Summons (putting a Thunder Type in the GY for Pot of Dichotomy!).
allow.Inspector Boarder: Level 4 LIGHT Machine (2000 ATK) that locks down monster effects on the field and provides a Machine Type for Pot of Dichotomy.
allow.Solemn Judgment: Limited to 1 in TCG: protects your stun board drawn by your Pot spells.
allow.Solemn Warning: Counter Trap that pays 2000 LP to negate a Summon or effect that summons.
allow.Gallant Granite: Rank 4 Rock Xyz (3 copies for Pot of Extravagance / Prosperity safety) that searches Koa'ki Meiru Guardian or Overload.
allow.Number 41: Bagooska the Terribly Tired T: Rank 4 Xyz (3 copies for Extravagance / Prosperity safety).

main: Spirit of the Pot of Greed
Iconic Level 1 LIGHT Fairy spirit of the Pot of Greed that presides over the Pot collection.
Avatar of The Pot
Iconic Level 3 EARTH Rock warrior wearing the Pot of Greed as armor.
Gren Maju Da Eiza
Primary win condition: gains +4000 ATK from Pot of Desires and +2400 ATK from Pot of Extravagance or Pot of Prosperity without needing to Special Summon!
Koa'ki Meiru Overload
1900 ATK Rock that tributes itself to negate any Summon, loading your GY for Pot of Avarice and Pot of Dichotomy.
Koa'ki Meiru Guardian
1900 ATK Rock that tributes itself to negate any monster effect, loading your GY for Pot of Avarice and Pot of Dichotomy.
Thunder King Rai-Oh
1900 ATK Thunder that locks down deck-searching while your Pot spells draw cards directly instead of searching, and tributes itself to negate Special Summons!
Inspector Boarder
2000 ATK Machine stun monster that provides a 3rd Monster Type for Pot of Dichotomy!
Pot of Desires
Banishes 10 cards from the top of your Deck face-down to draw 2 cards—giving Gren Maju Da Eiza +4000 ATK/DEF immediately!
Pot of Duality
Excavates the top 3 cards of your Deck, adds 1 of them to your hand, and shuffles the rest back into the Deck.
Pot of Extravagance
Limited to 1 in TCG: banishes 3 or 6 random face-down cards from your Extra Deck at the start of Main Phase 1 to draw 1 or 2 cards.
Pot of Prosperity
Limited to 1 in TCG: banishes 3 or 6 cards of your choice from your Extra Deck face-down to excavate 3 or 6 cards from the top of your Deck and add 1 to your hand!
Pot of Dichotomy
At the start of your Main Phase 1, targets 3 monsters with DIFFERENT Types in your GY, shuffles them into the Deck, and draws 2 cards!
Pot of Avarice
Targets 5 monsters in your GY, shuffles all 5 into the Deck, and draws 2 cards.
Pot of Acquisitiveness
Quick-Play Spell: targets 3 banished monsters, shuffles all 3 into the Deck, and draws 1 card!
Pot of Benevolence
Targets 2 cards in either GY(s) and shuffles them into the Deck.
Solemn Judgment
Limited to 1 in TCG: protects your board using the card advantage generated by your Pot spells.
Solemn Warning
Counter Trap: pays 2000 LP to negate a Summon or effect that summons.
extra: Number 41: Bagooska the Terribly Tired Tapir
Rank 4 Xyz (3 copies to fuel Pot of Extravagance and Pot of Prosperity while keeping 1 copy playable).
Rank 4 Rock Xyz (3 copies to fuel Pot of Extravagance and Pot of Prosperity) that searches Koa'ki Meiru Guardian or Overload.
